issues.description: The template's PersonResource.getAllPersons() returns ResponseEntity<List<Person>> while the solution's PersonResource.getAllPersons() returns ResponseEntity<Set<Person>>. The problem statement describes the Web Layer and PersonResource but does not define a different return type, so this is an unintended structural inconsistency between template and solution that may confuse students comparing implementations or trying to adapt tests or client code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the controller return type consistent across template and solution. Either change the solution's PersonResource.getAllPersons() signature to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> to match the template and service, or update the template/service to use Set<Person> consistently. Prefer aligning to ResponseEntity<List<Person>> since PersonService.getAll() currently returns List<Person>.
